newsitem.title: UK: Brent sells printing roller business.
newsitem.headline: Brent sells printing roller business.

text.p: Britain's Brent International Plc said on Thursday that it had sold its printing roller business, Sandon Flexographic, for 4.9 million stg.
Brent said it had sold the business to Praxair Surface Technologies Ltd.
The company was being paid four million stg for goodwill and 0.9 million stg for the estimated net book value of assets transferred.
Sandon's unaudited accounts shows it had recorded sales of 3.45 million stg in 1996 with profit before interest and tax showing 0.48 million stg.
"The proceeds will be used to reduce group borrowings," Brent said. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 4366
